text:
arjun: Noticing a small spike in SCIM provisioning failures for a handful of tenants. Error: signature verification failed on SAML assertion. Affected: orbit-co, lumen-pay, northbridge.

emily: Can you paste the exact error and an example assertion? 401 vs 403?

arjun: Mostly 401 when authn, 403 on deprovision flows. Sample log: 
```
error=assertion_verify_failed detail=Signature did not match expected thumbprint expected=sha1:ab12... actual=sha1:ff34... idp=okta-eu tenant=orbit-co
```

nate: We recently deployed metadata refresh throttling to reduce fetch spikes. If idp JWK set rotated upstream and our cached jwks didn't refresh we can get thumbprint mismatches.

ops-lee: Load balancer traces show these tenants hit proxies in eu-west-1 and eu-west-2. Cache hit rate for idp-jwks cache dropped to 40% during fetch backoff window.

emily: That matches. Okta sent a key rollover at 2026-03-21T01:43Z. Our refresh job backoff prevented immediate fetch; some pods continued verifying with old key.

arjun: Quick mitigation: force metadata/jwks refresh on all verifier pods and temporarily disable backoff for 15m. Can we do that?

ops-lee: Starting immediate job: POST /admin/refresh-jwks?force=true to verifier-service across clusters. Rolling restart not required. Running now.

sec-bot: verifier-service: refresh-jwks started by ops-lee (job id: jwk-refresh-20260321-01).

nate: Also adding a short-term fix: accept legacy thumbprint for 10m by checking envelope header for key-id and allowing fallback verification if the key-id is present and the issuer matches. Low risk because we still validate signature with the old key. Will ship as feature flag.

arjun: Good. For customers who've already failed deprovision, we should requeue those jobs after the refresh. Can we list failing tenants?

cs-anna: I pulled the ticket queue: orbit-co (15 failures), lumen-pay (7), northbridge (3). CS already got notified of auth failures.

emily: Post-fix telemetry actions: add jwk_key_id and jwk_thumbprint to assertion audit record, and record metadata_refresh_status in the tenant timeline. Also add an alert when JWK fetch backoffs > 5m for any issuer.

ops-lee: Refresh job completed across all clusters. Cache hit rate back to 98%. Error rate for assertion_verify_failed dropped to baseline.

arjun: Requeued provisioning tasks for the three tenants (job ids: rq-orbit-20260321-01, rq-lumen-20260321-01, rq-north-20260321-01).

nate: Filing SEC-460: "JWK refresh backoff allowed SAML key rollover to cause assertion thumbprint mismatches" with remediation steps: immediate forced refresh, fallback verify mode, telemetry additions, canary for metadata rollovers.

emily: Follow-ups: 
- Add per-issuer canary that validates new JWKs in a staging verifier before marking refresh success.
- Reduce aggressive backoff for identity metadata, use jittered exponential with max 30s during rotations.
- Provide CS script to mass-requeue tenant provision tasks.

arjun: Thanks. CS: please hold planned customer emails until we have audit lines with key_id/time for each failed assertion.

cs-anna: Will wait for audit enrichment then notify customers with timeline.

ops-lee: All clear from infra side. Closing incident once SEC-460 is in progress.

emily: Nice recovery. Adding a short post-mortem note and owners for the follow-ups. :thumbsup:
